description: Defines the 'Shortcut' entity class for Drupal, including its properties, methods, cache handling, and base field definitions.

classes.name: Shortcut
classes.description: Drupal entity class representing a shortcut link, with properties, cache management, and sorting functionality.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the shortcut.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the shortcut.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the shortcut for sorting.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the shortcut.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL the shortcut points to.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation after saving the entity, especially when a new shortcut is created.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the Shortcut entity, including id, uuid, title, weight, and link.

methods.name: getCacheTagsToInvalidate
methods.description: Returns cache tags to invalidate when the shortcut changes.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Static method to compare two shortcuts for sorting based on weight and title.
